Trek Clermont Saturday Group Ride

Clermont, FL

Trek Clermont Saturday Group Ride is a road group ride in Clermont, FL. It meets every Saturday, 7:30 am, starting at Trek Bicycle Clermont. Expect about 26–33 miles, group choice; some hills.

About the Trek Clermont Saturday Group Ride group ride

A weekly shop ride from the Trek store in Clermont, in the hills west of Orlando. About two and a half hours, 26 to 33 miles, route decided by the group. Details on the shop's Facebook events.
